data.one_liner: Manage auto-renewable subscriptions and in-app purchases without a backend server.
data.what_it_does: Integrates in-app purchases and subscriptions for iOS and Android apps. Provides real-time revenue analytics, A/B experiments, rules, and third-party integrations.
use_when: You need to handle in-app purchases and auto-renewable subscriptions without building a custom backend.
You want to run A/B pricing experiments and paywall tests.
You need real-time revenue analytics and third-party event integrations.
avoid_when: Your application does not use in-app purchases or subscriptions.
You require complex custom server-side receipt validation infrastructure built entirely in-house.
strengths: No server code required for managing subscriptions.
Supports A/B testing and paywall management out of the box.
Provides deep integration with multiple analytics and marketing third-party tools.
weaknesses: Relies on Apphud as a third-party infrastructure service.
Requires proper native configuration for billing libraries and capabilities.
data.setup_notes: Requires initializing with an API key, and configuring native store products. Android requires compileSdk 35 or higher in the latest versions.
